full_judgment: 2. Plaintiff-respondents filed the aforesaid suit for partition claiming 12 annas 10½ paisa share in the suit property stating, inter alia, that 15 acres of land with structures thereon in plot No.2379 of khatian No. 286 (old) khatian No. 409 (new). Mouza Kalishankarpur belonged to one Judhistir Chandra Nath who settled the same with Asia Khatun, the plaintiffs' mother, on 10th Aswin 1354 BS at a rent of Taka 5.00 per year. Possession thereof was delivered to the plaintiffs' mother who was the first wife of Md. Ibrahim. On 27-2-51 Judhistir transferred his malikana interest to Md. Ibrahim. The plaintiffs are the sons and daughters of Md. Ibrahim through his first wife Asia Khatun. Defendant Nos. 1 and 2 are Md. Ibrahim's son and daughter respectively through his second wife Lutfunnessa, defendant No.3 Asia Khatun used to live in a house on the suit land constructing a 6-room house in the southern side of the plot and letting out the rooms to different tenants. While in possession Asia Khatun died leaving behind her husband, two sons, plaintiff No.1 and Nurul Islam and four daughters. plaintiff-respondent Nos. 2-5. Nurul Islam died unmarried. Then died Ibrahim on 12-10-76 leaving behind two sons plaintiff No.1 and defendant No.1. second wife defendant No.3, and five daughters (plaintiff Nos.2-5 and defendant No.2). In this way the plaintiffs acquired 12 annas 10.50 paisa share in the suit property in respect of which they claimed partition.
